title: 01 — PHASES (Execution Roadmap)
summary: Execution roadmap defining nine phases P0-P8 mapped to Charter milestones M0-M7, each with goals, entry/exit criteria, deliverables, gates, and rollback conditions.
notes: Project-plan/roadmap document. No ADR signals (no Decision/Consequences, no status field), no user stories, no API/schema contracts. Exit criteria read as gating requirements, giving a weak PRD/SPEC signal, but dominant structure is sequencing and process guidance for a build plan -> DOC. References SPEC-01..09 and ADR IDs (AD-020, AD-030) as external authorities rather than defining them.
